title: ForTress: Bringing Assurance and Determinism for LLM-Driven Fortran-to-Python Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modernizing mature scientific software from Fortran to Python can improve accessibility and integration with modern computing tools, but manual rewriting is expensive. Large language models (LLMs) make translation more practical, yet generated code can pass regression tests while violating source-language semantics, and contextual corrections may not persist across subsequent translations. We present ForTress, which solidifies recurring LLM translation decisions into guarded executable rules for deterministic reuse and provides semantic assurance for a non-trivial subset of these rules. Its LLM-assisted auditing process expresses universally quantified preservation obligations over mechanized Fortran and Python semantics in Lean. Human experts review semantic fidelity and correspondence with production rules, and Lean's kernel checks proofs and refutations under explicit assumptions. translated_title: ForTress：为LLM驱动的Fortran到Python翻译带来保证与确定性
translated_abstract: 将成熟的科学软件从Fortran现代化迁移到Python可以提高可访问性并更好地与现代计算工具集成，但手动重写成本高昂。大型语言模型（LLM）使翻译变得更加实用，然而生成的代码可能在通过回归测试的同时违反源语言的语义，且上下文相关的修正可能无法在后续翻译中持久保留。我们提出ForTress，它将反复出现的LLM翻译决策固化为受保护的可执行规则，以实现确定性重用，并为这些规则中的一个非平凡子集提供语义保证。其LLM辅助的审计过程在Lean中基于机械化的Fortran和Python语义表达全称量化的保持义务。人类专家审查语义保真度以及与生产规则的对应关系，Lean的内核在明确的假设下检查证明与反驳。这些审计记录揭示了支持……（或反驳规则所依赖）的条件。
tldr: ForTress将LLM翻译决策固化为受保护的可执行规则以实现确定性重用，并通过Lean机械化证明为部分规则提供语义保证，从而提升Fortran到Python翻译的可靠性。
en_tdlr: ForTress solidifies recurring LLM translation decisions into guarded executable rules for deterministic reuse and provides semantic assurance for a subset of these rules via Lean-mechanized proofs, enhancing the reliability of Fortran-to-Python translation.
